people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
translations.bsb: No longer will you be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham, for I have made you a father of many nations.
translations.kjv: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
translations.asv: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for the father of a multitude of nations have I made thee.
